notes: M07-05 own-dependency review. Records every external surface this implementation actually depends on, why it is acceptable in a minimal stack, and how it is isolated. Native surfaces are called out because they are the hardest to replace. There is no package-manager dependency graph here: the toolchain is pinned, the OS tools are named, and HTTPS resolution uses only Python's isolated standard library before the guarded cURL transport. Go module ZIP verification uses the OS-provided zlib library only for raw DEFLATE and CRC32; parsing and checksum semantics stay in Elisa.

dependencies.isolation: build-time only; not present in produced binaries
dependencies.update_procedure: bump pinned rev, rebuild, run tools/check.sh; no `latest` in automation

dependencies.source: host LLVM Clang selected by ELISA_CLANG, ELISA_LLVM_BIN_DIR, or PATH
dependencies.pinned: not pinned; the M07 opt-in fuzz runner records the selected clang version
dependencies.isolation: opt-in build/test tool only; compiles the Elisa LLVM IR target with libFuzzer, AddressSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer, and sanitizer coverage; not linked into repo-health binaries
dependencies.update_procedure: record clang --version and rerun tests/test_m07_fuzz.sh and tests/test_m07_sanitizer.sh after changing the host LLVM toolchain

dependencies.isolation: only through a small declared extern set (system, mkdir, getenv, time, socket/fd calls) in rh_base and rh_http
dependencies.update_procedure: externs are minimal and documented; a libc change is caught by the suite

dependencies.pinned: no version pin; system library resolved by the host linker
dependencies.isolation: linked only into rh_cli for Go module ZIP observation; called for raw DEFLATE decoding and CRC32 only, with compressed and expanded byte caps; no path, filesystem, or network access
dependencies.update_procedure: the Go ZIP fixture and adversarial CRC/expansion cases plus the full tools/check.sh gate must pass on each supported host

dependencies.pinned: version captured into every scan's evidence (git-version.txt)
dependencies.isolation: invoked only via allowlisted arguments; plumbing commands only
dependencies.update_procedure: tool version is evidenced per scan; a format change fails the log parse rather than producing wrong numbers

dependencies.pinned: no version pin; flags are constants
dependencies.isolation: user config disabled, proxies bypassed, --resolve pins all validated DNS answers, proto restricted to https+file, redirects disabled, byte/time caps, no auth header
dependencies.update_procedure: flag set is fixed in rh_git; a change requires re-running the transport tests

dependencies.pinned: not pinned; Python 3 executable must be on PATH for HTTPS fetches
dependencies.isolation: used only for bounded HTTPS hostname resolution via python3 -I -S -c; imports standard-library socket and threading only; resolver output is capped and each address passes rh_addr_guard before cURL --resolve
dependencies.update_procedure: a resolver or interpreter change requires the M07 DNS pinning tests and full tools/check.sh gate

rules: runtime network access only through the guarded transport, never from metrics or policy
no package manager resolves dependencies at build or run time
native surfaces (POSIX libc and OS-provided zlib) are enumerated here and kept to the smallest required call set
LLVM Clang/libFuzzer is an opt-in development test dependency; parser logic and the callable target remain Elisa
an added dependency requires an update to this review and an ADR if it changes the stack
the HTTPS resolver runs only with isolated Python standard-library imports; no third-party Python package is loaded
not_covered: no transitive package SBOM is produced because there is no package manager in the stack
OS tool versions other than git are not evidenced per run
